strategy_roster.name: XROC2 VG X2
strategy_roster.notes: The two-timeframe system is collapsed to one series: a fast ROC(5) crossing a slow ROC(20) gives the lower-timeframe signal and a 50-bar ROC acts as the directional filter. No fast/slow periods are documented, so 5/20/50 are fallbacks, and the Jurik smoothing, signal-bar shifts and money management are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Volatility Bias Model
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > sma(close,10) and roc(close,10) > 0 and (high - low) / close > 0.05
strategy_roster.notes: The bullish-close count over BiasWindow=10 is approximated by price above its 10-bar average with positive 10-bar change, and RangeMin=0.05 is used literally as a price-fraction range gate. RiskReward=2 ATR targets, the ATR(14) stop and the MaxBars=20 timer are not expressible exits.

strategy_roster.name: Liquidex Keltner
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(close,sma(close,7) + atr(high,low,close,6)) and close > sma(close,7) and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: MaPeriod=7 and KeltnerPeriod=6 with KeltnerMultiplier=1 are documented, so the band is SMA(7) plus one ATR(6) and the long requires a close above both the band and the average with a bullish body. RangeFilter=10 points, the EntryHour window and the Friday cutoff are not expressible; StopLoss=1m and TakeProfit=2m are percentage-based.

strategy_roster.name: Forex Fraus Slogger
strategy_roster.notes: With a 1-period SMA the envelopes are the previous close plus/minus EnvelopePercent=0.1, so the documented re-entry above the lower band is written as a one-bar ROC crossing 0.1 and the mirror exit at -0.1. The trailing stop (0.001/0.0001) and the StartHour/StopHour filter are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Hulk Grid Algorithm V2
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy places ten layered limit buys around a user-supplied MidPrice (default 0, i.e. unanchored) and exits the whole basket on percentage stop or target, so it is a multi-order grid engine with no market-derived entry. The never-true guard is used even though StopLossPercent=2.0 and TakeProfitPercent=2.0 are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Viva Las Vegas
strategy_roster.notes: Direction comes from a pseudo-random coin toss (Seed, even time-seeded) and sizing from one of five staking progressions, so no deterministic single-symbol signal exists. The never-true guard prevents fabricating one; StopTakePips=50 is a pip offset, not a percentage.

strategy_roster.name: Night Scalper
strategy_roster.entry_long: close < bb_lower(close,40,1) and bb_upper(close,40,1) - bb_lower(close,40,1) < sma(bb_upper(close,40,1) - bb_lower(close,40,1),20)
strategy_roster.notes: Documented BB Period=40 with Deviation=1 is used, and the Range Threshold=450 point width test is restated relative to the band's own 20-bar average because absolute points are not portable. Start Hour=19 gating and the Stop Loss 370 / Take Profit 20 point offsets are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Signal Tester
strategy_roster.notes: The documented behaviour is to buy whenever flat and sell on the very next candle, which is a deliberately indicator-free one-bar round trip, so both sides use an always-true price test. The engine's next-bar-open execution reproduces the alternating long/flat pattern and only costs are incurred.

strategy_roster.name: Month of Year Effect
strategy_roster.notes: Entries and month-end exits come from a calendar effect on 15-minute bars with no indicators, which the DSL cannot express without date fields. The documented 2% stop is left null because the never-true guard opens no positions.

strategy_roster.name: Speedometer Toolbox
strategy_roster.notes: The docs describe a visualisation-only gauge that draws an RSI speedometer (RsiLength=14, Radius=20) and explicitly list entry criteria none. There is no trading logic to translate, so the never-true guard is used.
